scope: Public FluidState raw-property binding and complete-state indexing; retained numerical and error semantics.

diagnosis.raw_property: Equinox created a new callable Module and copied method-wrapper metadata for each public method lookup. The 20-dictionary profile contained 260 BoundMethod constructions; alias/schema lookup itself was inexpensive.
diagnosis.at_index: Eager per-leaf JAX gathers and PyTree reconstruction added overhead while returning the new complete numerical schema. Indexing must continue returning all fields, status and optional clipping flags.
retained_fixes: A lightweight frozen and weak-referenceable callable PyTree binds raw_property and at_index. Function identity is static; the owning state's numerical leaves remain dynamic when the method is passed through JAX/Equinox transformations.
Class-level calls, __self__/__func__/__wrapped__, signatures, function metadata, pickle and tree reconstruction are preserved without using private Equinox implementation classes.

One JAX gather handles every standard state's numerical property, status and optional clipping leaf. Public index type, static-tracer and bounds checks remain outside the kernel; its internal index is dynamic.
Ordinary NumPy indexing retains read-only views and storage. Validated metadata remains outside the gather kernel; subclass indexing retains its general PyTree path.
diagnosis.native_assembly: The unused experimental batch_fast_path option was removed. The original native assembly behavior, including its existing size-64 branch, is retained.

focused_verification.command: python -m pytest tests/test_phase13_state_helpers.py tests/test_fluid_state.py tests/test_native_state_factory.py tests/test_evaluator_state_metadata.py -c tests/pytest.ini -q --tb=short --disable-warnings
checks: Dynamic method-as-argument JIT/filter-JIT calls observe changed state arrays without retracing.
Direct bound-method JIT, gradients, vmap, tree updates, introspection, immutable bindings and pickle/tree round trips.
Alias/schema errors, guarded unavailable properties and raw unavailable numerical values.
Complete indexed values, metadata, status, availability and clipping; scalar identity, static bounds, float0 tangent bookkeeping, gradients and NumPy/JAX storage.
Existing small/large native masking paths at sizes 16 and 128 preserve failed rows, clipping and gradients.
focused_verification.black_check: Passed for jaxprop/fluid_state.py and tests/test_phase13_state_helpers.py with --check --workers 1.

provisional_diagnostics.profile: Prepared Air perfect-gas states, CPU/x64; direct public helpers, not thermodynamic state evaluation.
provisional_diagnostics.measurement: Minimum of three short timeit repeats; 200 raw dictionaries or 30 synchronized complete-state index calls per repeat. The after-index kernel was warmed once.
limitations: These short process-local diagnostics established the overhead and supported the fix; they are not isolated multiworker PyPI acceptance measurements.
The raw dictionary diagnostic calls the public getter directly; the maintained gate also includes its benchmark API and complete synchronization overhead.

The after probe preceded removal of an unused native-factory prototype option. Its default preserved the existing path and the retained getter/index algorithms are unchanged; final acceptance must use the final frozen source hash.
No universal backend, device, shape or first-compilation speedup is inferred. Cold gather compilation and final warmed timings are assessed separately by the maintained Phase 13 gate.
